title: Close a tab and a workspace, walk Recently Closed and reopen one, search for nothing, clear the closed history, switch sidebar items and open the History page
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab, an empty closed history

steps.note: a second workspace below the launch's; a socket run files it without showing it, so the first stays selected
New Terminal Tab (newSurface): a second, selected terminal tab in the first workspace
closes new-tab's idle shell into the closed history (no question: it runs nothing)
closes the workspace new-workspace made; a scripted run of a destructive action passes confirm (ActionRegistry+Confirmation)
Recently Closed…: the palette's closed page, newest first (the workspace, then the tab)
Next Item, the action Down runs in the open palette: the selection moves to the closed tab. debug.key would reach the shell window, not the palette panel, so the palette's own actions drive it
Previous Item (Up): back to the closed workspace
Palette: Run Item (Return) runs the selected row's reopen: the closed workspace comes back and its entry leaves the closed history
the sidebar's Search scope with a query nothing matches (palette.open; a socket run opens it only with focus): its bounded empty state
Palette: Clear or Close (Escape) on an opened scope with a query clears the query (PaletteNavReducer.escape)
Escape again with an empty query closes the palette
a scoped clear: only the closed items of the last hour; page, location, command and agent history stay
Recently Closed with nothing closed: the palette's empty state, no stale row
Palette: Clear or Close (Escape) with an empty query closes the palette
Focus Sidebar: the keyboard moves to the sidebar's rows
Next Sidebar Item: the selection moves to the reopened workspace, and its row and the shown workspace agree
the History page opens as a page tab in the focused pane of the shown workspace

invariants: close-tab and close-workspace each add exactly one closed entry, newest first, with the kind and workspace of what closed

the Recently Closed rows are the closed history's entries in its order, and walk-down and walk-up move the selection one row each way; the Search scope with a query nothing matches shows an empty list, not an error
reopen-row brings back the row it selected (the workspace, with the public id it had) and removes exactly that entry
clear-closed empties the closed history only; Recently Closed then shows its empty state
after next-sidebar-item the sidebar's selected row and the topology's focused workspace are the same workspace
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
the turn checkpoint of each step that records one is a prefix of its settled checkpoint (I3)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: typing into the palette or the sidebar's filter field: debug.key reaches the shell window, not the palette panel, so the query comes from palette.open and the palette's own actions (Next Item, Run Item, Clear or Close) stand for its keys
paging past one page of closed entries: the fixture closes two items
the History page's own rows and their clear buttons: the webviews facet is not asserted (p15-oracle-215)
an error state of the closed history: an offline launch has no failing source to show
